> Cosmetic and plastic surgery clinic in Goa, India, led by Dr. Manish Patel (MBBS · MS (General Surgery) · MCh (Plastic Surgery)), with 30+ years of experience. Clinics in Margao and Panaji.

- Registration: Goa Medical Council, Reg. No. awaiting confirmation.
- Positions and teaching: Head, Department of Cosmetic Surgery, Wockhardt Institute of Aesthetics (2011); faculty at IAAPS AESURG 2022; faculty and trainer for Botox and fillers at the 7th FADS World Congress 2023, South Goa.
- Content policy: following the National Medical Commission's Guidelines on Ethical Advertising and Public Communication (6 October 2026), the site publishes no patient testimonials, reviews or before-and-after images. ## Quick answers
### How can I check a plastic surgeon’s qualifications in India?
Ask for the surgeon’s degrees and medical council registration number, then look the registration up on the National Medical Commission’s Indian Medical Register or the State Medical Council’s register. In India the specialist degree in plastic surgery is MCh (Plastic Surgery) or DNB (Plastic Surgery).

### What qualifications does Dr. Manish Patel have?
Dr. Manish Patel holds MBBS, MS (General Surgery) and MCh (Plastic Surgery). He is registered with the Goa Medical Council and has practised for more than 30 years.

### Where are the clinics located?
There are two clinics in Goa: Margao (near B101, CD Signature, Bolshe Cir, Borda, 403602) and Panaji (1st Floor, 112-A, Gerra Imperium Star, Patto, next to State Central Library, 403001).

### Which procedures do you offer?
Surgical procedures include hair transplant (FUE and FUT), rhinoplasty, liposuction, breast augmentation, gynecomastia surgery, facelift and tummy tuck. Non-surgical and skin treatments include Botox, fillers, laser hair removal, acne scar treatment and skin rejuvenation.

### How much do treatments cost?
Cost depends on the procedure, its extent and your individual plan, so a fair figure is only possible after an examination. You receive a written estimate after your consultation, with no obligation to go ahead.

### Why are there no patient reviews or before-and-after photos on this website?
The National Medical Commission’s guidelines on ethical advertising do not allow doctors to publish patient testimonials, reviews or before-and-after results to promote their practice. At your consultation Dr. Patel explains what a procedure can and cannot change for you, including its risks.

### How do I make an appointment?
Call the Margao clinic on +91 92845 62451 or the Panaji clinic on +91 97308 56787, message the clinic on WhatsApp, or send the enquiry form on the contact page.

### Is plastic surgery safe?
Every surgical procedure carries risk, including bleeding, infection, scarring, anaesthetic complications and a result that differs from what you hoped for. Risk is reduced, not removed, by a full assessment, an equipped facility and careful aftercare. Each procedure’s specific risks are discussed with you before you decide.
